description: Find tools that are not in your tool list (it holds the everyday ones; every other tool is still callable). Give query words (e.g. "hashtag search") and optionally an area; returns up to 10 matches with name, one-line description, the permissions it needs and its input schema. Run a match with tool_call (name, arguments). Pass name for one tool's full description and full schema (use it when a schema comes back as an outline). With no query it lists the areas. A match with callable false names the missing permission and the one link where a person turns it on.

area.description: Narrow to one area from the areas list, e.g. "Links" or "Giveaways"

name.description: One tool's exact name, e.g. "edit_change": returns its full description and full schema

query.description: Words for what you want to do, e.g. "competitor posts" or "giveaway winners"

name: tool_search
title: Find a tool
